async def act(page):
    # Try to find the homepage URL field by label 'Homepage URL' or 'Website'
    try:
        await page.get_by_label("Homepage URL").fill("https://egg.tart.com")
    except:
        try:
            await page.get_by_label("Website").fill("https://egg.tart.com")
        except:
            # If label not found, try to find by placeholder or other attributes
            await page.get_by_placeholder("Homepage URL").fill("https://egg.tart.com")
    # Find and click the save button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save changes").click()
    # Wait for changes to be saved
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
